THE COLOMBO PORT CITY ECONOMIC COMMISSION ACT, No. 11 OF 2021
Order under Section 53

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Section 53 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, I, Ranil Wickremesinghe, Minister of Investment Promotion, having considered the recommendations of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission and upon the approval of the Cabinet of Ministers, do by this Order specify that-
(a) the Cabinet of Ministers, by its decision No. 24/1304/631/032 dated, July 09, 2024 has approved the designation
of the business of the authorised person specified in Schedule I hereto as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance;
(b) the rationale for considering such business as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance is as specified in
Schedule II hereto;
(c) the exemptions or incentives granted under the enactments shall be as specified in Schedule III hereto; and
(d) the exemptions or incentives granted under the enactments specified shall commence and cease to be operative
on the dates specified in Schedule IV hereto.
Ranil Wickremesinghe, Minister of Investment Promotion.
Colombo, July 19, 2024.

Schedule II
Rationale for the consideration of the Secondary Business of Strategic Importance

The objectives of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission, as stipulated in Section 5 of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021, have been considered in designating the business as a Secondary Business of Strategic Importance, in order to ensure the success of establishing the Colombo Port City, having regard to the national interest or the advancement of the national economy as provided for in Section 53(5) of the said Act.

HEXAWARE TECHNOLOGIES SL (PRIVATE) LIMITED, a company incorporated in Sri Lanka, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hexaware Technologies Limited, a global IT and BPO services company with an annual global revenue of over USD 50 million, incorporated in India. Leveraging its global presence with offices in the United Staes, Canada, Europe, Singapore and Australia, Hexaware serves a diverse clientele across industries such as banking and financial services, healthcare, insurance, travel and manufacturing.

HEXAWARE TECHNOLOGIES SL (PRIVATE) LIMITED's strategic focus within the Colombo Port City centers on exporting IT services and solutions to the United States of America and Europe, targeting sectors including travel and transportation, hospitality, logistics, and banking and financial services. The company will offer a comprehensive suite of services including application development and management, enterprise resource planning solutions, infrastructure management, business intelligence and analytics, and digital assurance and testing. With a planned investment of USD 50,000, Hexaware SL aligns with Sri Lanka's national goals by fostering talent development and innovation through employee IT training programs, thereby contributing to human capital development and social inclusion.

Hexaware Technologies SL projects the hiring of 90 individuals in the first year, followed by 50 in the second year. Hiring is expected to increase to 90 in year three, with a projected 145 individuals being employed in year four. With an additional 225 in the fifth year, the cumulative total at the end of year five will be 600 employees. Hexaware Technologies SL is projecting a business volume of USD 75-100 million within five years, Hexaware Technologies SL also incorporates green IT initiatives such as energy-efficient technologies and renewable energy solutions, adhering to the Colombo Port City's sustainable principles.
